title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - GeographicAddress
description: Structured textual way of describing how to find a Property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). Note : Address corresponds to SID UrbanPropertyAddress (TM Forum TMF673 API Place - GeographicAddress 4.0.1, Swagger definition GeographicAddress; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:GeographicAddress:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GeographicAddress'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:GeographicAddress:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the place

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/href'. Unique reference of the place

city.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/city'. City that the address is in

country.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/country'. Country that the address is in

locality.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/locality'. An area of defined or undefined boundaries within a local authority or other legislatively defined area, usually rural or semi rural in nature. [ANZLIC-STREET], or a suburb, a bounded locality within a city, town or shire principally of urban character [ANZLICSTREET]

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/name'. A user-friendly name for the place, such as [Paris Store], [London Store], [Main Home]

postcode.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/postcode'. descriptor for a postal delivery area, used to speed and simplify the delivery of mail (also know as zipcode)

stateOrProvince.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/stateOrProvince'. the State or Province that the address is in

streetName.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/streetName'. Name of the street or other street type

streetNr.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/streetNr'. Number identifying a specific property on a public street. It may be combined with streetNrLast for ranged addresses

streetNrLast.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/streetNrLast'. Last number in a range of street numbers allocated to a property

streetNrLastSuffix.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/streetNrLastSuffix'. Last street number suffix for a ranged address

streetNrSuffix.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/streetNrSuffix'. the first street number suffix

streetSuffix.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/streetSuffix'. A modifier denoting a relative direction

streetType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/streetType'. alley, avenue, boulevard, brae, crescent, drive, highway, lane, terrace, parade, place, tarn, way, wharf

geographicLocation.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/geographicLocation'. A GeographicLocation is a pure-virtual super-class to the GeoJSON-aligned geometries of Point (addresses and locations), MultiPoint, LineString (streets, highways and boundaries), MultiLineString and Polygon (countries, provinces, tracts of land). Use the @type attribute to specify which of these is being specified by the geometry attribute. In TMF this is a GeographicLocationRefOrValue object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced GeographicLocation entity (urn:ngsi-ld:GeographicLocation:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

geographicSubAddress.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/geographicSubAddress'. Representation of a GeographicSubAddress It is used for addressing within a property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). It may refer to a building, a building cluster, or a floor of a multistory building.

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF673_GeographicAddress/blob/v4.0.0/TMF673-GeographicAddress-v4.0.1.swagger.json#/definitions/GeographicAddress/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'GeographicAddress' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name

GeographicSubAddress.description: Representation of a GeographicSubAddress It is used for addressing within a property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). It may refer to a building, a building cluster, or a floor of a multistory building.

buildingName.description: allows for buildings that have well-known names

levelNumber.description: used where a level type may be repeated e.g. BASEMENT 1, BASEMENT 2

levelType.description: describes level types within a building

name.description: Name of the subAddress to identify it with a meaningful identification

privateStreetName.description: private streets internal to a property (e.g. a university) may have internal names that are not recorded by the land title office.

privateStreetNumber.description: private streets numbers internal to a private street

subAddressType.description: Type of subAddress : it can be a subunit or a private street

subUnitNumber.description: the discriminator used for the subunit often just a simple number e.g. FLAT 5, may also be a range

subUnitType.description: the type of subunit e.g.BERTH, FLAT, PIER, SUITE, SHOP, TOWER, UNIT, WHARF

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name
